repos.name: yubios
repos.description: yubiOS container images: production, dev/test, installer, RK firmware. By yubi-OS CI.
repos.full_description:
Published by [yubi-OS/yubiOS](https://github.com/yubi-OS/yubiOS) CI.

Tags:
- `yubios`, `yubios:<sha>` - production image
- `yubios-dev`, `yubios-dev:<sha>` - TEST-only dev image (software FIDO2, ADR-026)
- `installer`, `installer:<sha>` - mkosi installer image with signed UKI
- `firmware[-sha]`, `firmware-qemu-arm64[-sha]`, `firmware-rock5b-rk3588[-sha]`, `firmware-rockpro64-rk3399[-sha]` - RK firmware bundles

Digest-pinned bases; builds pass the `yubiOS.rego` OPA policy.
